html:
The Djerimanga, also known as the Wulna or Woolna, are an Aboriginal people of the Northern Territory, in coastal country east of Darwin around the mouth of the Adelaide River and Adam Bay.

They were close partners of the Larrakia, with whom they shared ceremonies and songlines and married. Neighbours inland were the Limilngan and the Awarai.

In 1864 South Australia set up a short lived settlement at Escape Cliffs on Adam Bay, in their country, before choosing Darwin harbour instead. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. For the wider story, see Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Djerimanga, also known as the Wulna or Woolna, are an Aboriginal people of the Northern Territory, in coastal country east of Darwin around the mouth of the Adelaide River and Adam Bay.
